sections.heading: Work zones, road rules, restraints and phones
sections.markdown:
## Work zones, road rules, restraints and phones

FACT_ID: sec06-F01 | anchor: A01
A work zone may cover work on the road, its shoulders or nearby areas, including moving operations such as utility work, surveying or snow removal. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=23]

FACT_ID: sec06-F02 | anchor: A01
Work-zone signs, pavement markings and flaggers direct traffic through the work area or a marked detour. Orange warns of road work. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=23]

FACT_ID: sec06-F03 | anchor: A01
Work-zone warning signs use a black legend or symbol on an orange background. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=23]

FACT_ID: sec06-F04 | anchor: A01
Obey a reduced posted work-zone limit. If no reduced limit is posted, obey the road's normal limit while taking extra care for workers, lane position and road conditions. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=23]

FACT_ID: sec06-F05 | anchor: A01
An orange advisory-speed sign identifies a suitable speed for a particular work-zone condition; a regulatory reduction is shown by the standard black-and-white speed-limit sign. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=23]

FACT_ID: sec06-F06 | anchor: A01
A work-zone flagger has regulatory authority. Follow the flagger's traffic directions. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=23]

FACT_ID: sec06-F07 | anchor: A01
Yield to work vehicles displaying flashing or rotating amber warning lights, and slow as you approach the work area. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=23]

FACT_ID: sec06-F08 | anchor: A01
When lanes narrow or close near workers, move to another lane if possible. Otherwise create more separation within your own lane without crossing its boundaries. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=23]

FACT_ID: sec06-F09 | anchor: A01
Moving work vehicles may travel extremely slowly or stop in the traffic lane. Slow, yield and follow their displayed arrows or directions. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=23]

FACT_ID: sec06-F10 | anchor: A01
When entering a work zone, watch speed signs, position the vehicle away from workers where possible and prepare for unexpected changes. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=23]

FACT_ID: sec06-F11 | anchor: A02
Enter or leave a controlled-access road only through an authorized entrance or exit, and obey signs excluding particular vehicle types. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=24]

FACT_ID: sec06-F12 | anchor: A02
Reversing on a controlled-access roadway is prohibited. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=24]

FACT_ID: sec06-F13 | anchor: A02
Do not enter a reversible express lane when its access gates are already closed or are closing. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=24]

FACT_ID: sec06-F14 | anchor: A02
When descending a hill, do not coast with the transmission or gears in neutral. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=24]

FACT_ID: sec06-F15 | anchor: A02
Driving is unlawful when alcohol, an illegal or prescribed drug, or another substance impairs safe vehicle operation. A prescription does not excuse driving impairment. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=24]

FACT_ID: sec06-F16 | anchor: A02
Reckless driving means operating with disregard for the safety of people or property; the handbook gives unsafe speed, weaving and improper passing as examples. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=24]

FACT_ID: sec06-F17 | anchor: A02
Street racing includes competing with other vehicles, accelerating or maneuvering to keep a competing driver from passing, or competing against a clock. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=24]

FACT_ID: sec06-F18 | anchor: A02
Aggressive driving involves operating with an intent to harass, intimidate, injure or obstruct another person. Examples include tailgating, cutting someone off and blocking a pass or lane change. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=24]

FACT_ID: sec06-F19 | anchor: A02
The handbook's reckless-stunt-driving description includes drag racing or laying drags in disregard of safety on a highway or on private property without the owner's express permission. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=24]

FACT_ID: sec06-F20 | anchor: A02
Outside business and residential districts, trucks and vehicles towing trailers must leave enough space between similar vehicles for an overtaking vehicle to enter safely; closely grouped caravanning is prohibited. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=24]

FACT_ID: sec06-F21 | anchor: A02
The handbook prohibits trailers wider than 8 feet 6 inches on Georgia highways. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=24]

FACT_ID: sec06-F22 | anchor: A02
Passengers may not ride inside a house trailer or another towed trailer while it is moving on a street or highway. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=24]

FACT_ID: sec06-F23 | anchor: A02
Cross a divided-road median, barrier or unpaved separating strip only at an authorized opening or crossover. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=24]

FACT_ID: sec06-F24 | anchor: A02
Do not use a headset or another device that impairs hearing while driving, or wear anything that blocks vision. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=24]

FACT_ID: sec06-F25 | anchor: A02
Do not drive an overloaded vehicle when passengers or freight obstruct the driver's view or interfere with vehicle operation. Passengers must not occupy a position that hinders the view or control. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=24]

FACT_ID: sec06-F26 | anchor: A02
Open a door beside moving traffic only when safe and without interfering with passing vehicles or bicycles. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=24]

FACT_ID: sec06-F27 | anchor: A02
Follow the posted direction of a one-way road unless a traffic-control device or authorized traffic director directs otherwise; the handbook also recognizes official emergency-vehicle exceptions. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=24]

FACT_ID: sec06-F28 | anchor: A02
Give the appropriate hand, arm or brake-light signal when slowing or stopping suddenly. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=24]

Misconceptions: Hands-free equipment does not authorize distracted driving or equipment that impairs hearing; an advisory speed and a regulatory limit have different roles.
Mnemonic: Slow, observe, give room, follow directions.
Glossary: An advisory speed is guidance for the particular warned condition; a controlled-access roadway has designated entrances and exits.
Dynamic-fact isolation: Penalty schedules, toll interoperability, restraint exemptions and incomplete statutory summaries remain current-official-source review.

verification_debt.claim_text: The dated handbook facts retain source freshness, rights and independent factual-review debt; no current-law equivalence or live service/fee policy is certified.
Work-zone fatality statistics and historical worker totals are not verified current and are withheld.

Work-zone, impairment, reckless/aggressive/stunt-driving, litter and phone fines, jail terms, points, suspension durations, restoration charges and limited-permit schedules are withheld pending current legal confirmation.
Blood-alcohol numeric clauses on this page use a mass expression without a complete concentration unit; no percentage is inferred here. The later impairment section must be read separately.
Toll-pass registration, reciprocity and violation notices are changing service policy and withheld pending current issuer evidence.
The child-restraint summary notes additional exemptions without enumerating them. This is an incomplete handbook summary; no exhaustive current exemption list is asserted.
The hands-free summary does not enumerate every statutory exception; current exceptions and applicability require official verification.
The postal/sanitation fallback-speed comparison uses the same awkward fixed-speed/reduction wording as the bicycle rule. Its exact numeric comparison is withheld pending authoritative clarification.
Work-zone sign drawings are not reproduced or treated as image-recognition evidence.
